trends.description: All major competitors now prominently display battery health percentages. Customers increasingly sophisticated about this metric.
trends.impact: High - customers expect specific battery capacity info, not just 'good battery'
trends.opportunity: Guarantee minimum battery health, display exact percentages

trends.description: Move beyond simple A/B/C grades to detailed cosmetic descriptions
trends.impact: Medium - customers want to know exact condition details
trends.opportunity: Provide detailed condition photos and descriptions per device

trends.description: Eco-conscious messaging becoming more prominent, especially targeting Gen Z
trends.impact: Medium - appeals to environmentally conscious buyers
trends.opportunity: Emphasize environmental benefits of refurbished vs new

trends.description: iPhone 15 switch to USB-C creating accessory compatibility confusion
trends.impact: High - perfect opportunity for curated bundles with correct accessories
trends.opportunity: Create clear compatibility guides and bundle correct cables/chargers

trends.trend: New Model Impact on Refurb Supply
trends.description: iPhone 15 launch caused 12% price drop in older refurbished models due to increased supply
trends.impact: High - timing purchases around new releases maximizes savings
trends.opportunity: Market timing messaging around new release cycles
